notes.title: ColonyLog #3: Biome Transitions, Air Conditioning and More!
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Survivors![/p][p]With your feedback, we continue to improve our game in small steps. This update brings a diverse world and more depth to the gameplay. Let’s take a look at what we’ve added this time:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What We’ve Done[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Biome Transition System [/b]Now, you'll need to clear blocked paths to enter new biomes! To do this, you'll need to provide the workers at the gates with the necessary items. Once you help them, they'll clear the path, allowing you to move on to the next biome.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Conditioning System
[/b]Passengers are now affected by temperature depending on the biome![/p][list][*][p]In the snowy biome, passengers get cold,[/p][/*][*][p]In the desert, they overheat.
By purchasing air conditioning cards, you can activate your vehicle’s AC and keep your passengers comfortable.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tire Tracks
[/b]Vehicles now leave biome-specific tire tracks, making the driving experience more immersive and realistic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Areas[/b][/p][p]Biome transition points have been designed and modeled. You can now discover these new passage zones![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/c883b42b5a7df214a0fef093c6ecc83c8f8a018e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed missing elements and issues in levels.[/p][olist][*][p]Snow biome trees have been reorganized.[/p][/*][*][p]Desert and snow biomes with detailed roads.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Shader issues fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Other drivable vehicles have been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes applied.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The game economy will be structured[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix[/p][/*][/list][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/4eded77d932cbd253882654f23b105c9a38d189e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/bbc58a4432553d80a70c91106a191ddb2e314255.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/0ad08a1f707ea068f49c2e02ecf0b69eaa6015be.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: ColonyLog #2: New Explorations, Bandit Camps and New Passenger System!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, dear friends! We've been working hard since the last update, continuing to improve the game based on your feedback. Our world is now larger, and the adventures are more dangerous! Here's what we've done in this update:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What We’ve Done[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]New Areas to Explore
10[/b] new areas have been added to the game for you to explore![/p][/*][*][p][b]Bandit Camps
3 [/b]new bandit camps have been added to the map. Enemies guard these areas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passenger Hunger and Thirst System.
[/b]A brand new mechanic is here! The passengers you carry will have hunger and thirst needs. You'll need to provide them with food and water throughout the journey.[/p][p]If you can't afford these needs, your passenger earnings will decrease. This system adds new depth to the game, both in terms of strategy and resource management.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Tutorial System
[/b]We've updated the tutorial system. It's now designed to teach passengers' hunger and thirst mechanics step-by-step, so you can easily grasp this new system from the very beginning of the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/2526f262cccd7ad820ddd691a810b377adc591b2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Minor bugs have been fixed, and the gaming experience has been made smoother.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improvements to the game economy[/p][/*][*][p]A more dynamic world experience with the addition of new weather conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Additional depth to the survival system awaits you![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/6c094d3084d51caa0a205cf14d73aa660b26e18a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/ef453aee561b1cf66b966063c96defb32baf0697.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/bec4bf6f5c42e52bf49d25cbe37b5d04c2528dae.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/151f1a6b3abe8a79edfc70958997f67c9ae84c7e.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: ColonyLog #1: Developments, Changes, and New Systems
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, dear friends!   After releasing our first demo, we've received a lot of feedback, and with the input we’ve gathered, we’ve made updates to some key aspects of the game. This devlog is here to walk you through what we’ve done so far, which systems we’ve improved, and what we’ve brought to you. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What We’ve Done[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Desert Cities Designed
[/b]We’ve designed the cities in our new Desert biome. You’ll experience the challenges of surviving in barren lands, and the gameplay will be shaped around this new area. Unique structures and ways of life can be found in FIREPIT and HEATSHARD. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Desert Biome Development
[/b]Work on the Desert biome is still ongoing. This region will present players with a unique challenge, featuring harsh survival elements, resource limitations, and local threats. The initial design stages have been completed. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Artificial Intelligence Innovations
[/b]We’ve overhauled the AI system, resulting in a smoother and more realistic experience. NPCs now interact with their environment more consistently, and their reactions have become more natural. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Slingshot System Revamped
[/b]In previous versions, using slingshots was a complex process, requiring players to pick them up from the ground. Now, thanks to the Pie Menu system, players can quickly select and use these tools. Additionally, players can carry objects during attacks, offering a more dynamic experience. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tutorial System
[/b]We’ve revamped our tutorial system. Integrated with the Pie Menu system, everything flows much more smoothly and intuitively. Players will now be guided through the steps to learn new systems in a more streamlined and instructional way. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/09c155f5c370629fec2251d71985c713efef7bd9.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b] [/h3][p]During the demo process, we identified a few issues based on user feedback and quickly fixed them: [/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Some visual bugs were resolved. [/p][/*][*][p]The AI was exhibiting unpredictable behaviors in certain places; this has been optimized. [/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial-breaking bugs were fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugs were fixed. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We're continuing to work on AI. With the latest update, NPCs are now more responsive to their environments. However this is just the beginning. in the next phase, NPCs will now respond more meaningfully to player events, not just events. [/p][/*][*][p]Players can now safely save their adventures! We will be integrating the save system. [/p][/*][*][p]More discoveries, more secrets! We will add new places to explore to the map. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/0d5653cd50894f5c9fc0a9d2fcc18d98d826331e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/eb31c82d3a99039b8941ea025ed7012d6b521ee8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184750/51096ed3b60b7d5f419fc65597bc34c492eb92a6.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]Player Feedback[/b] [/h3][p]If you’ve got a minute, we’d appreciate your feedback. Just hit the button below - it helps more than you think. We’ll randomly pick 5 responses to receive a free full-game key at launch. [/p][p] [/p][p] [url="https://forms.gle/ZpbqpkExLdVpcRmi8" style="button"]User Survey[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🚚 Intercolonies – Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,
We're excited to finally share the [b]demo for Intercolonies[/b] with you.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264450/Intercolonies_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This is a personal project we’ve been pouring everything into - a game about surviving the journey between broken colonies in a post-apocalyptic world. In this demo, you’ll play through one transport mission set in the first biome. Just you, your vehicle, your passengers… and whatever waits out there.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 What you can try in the demo:[/h3][list][*][p]One full trip between the two colonies[/p][/*][*][p]A look at the first biome and how the world works[/p][/*][*][p]Driving, exploration, decision-making, and danger[/p][/*][*][p]A small slice of the mood and survival experience we’re building[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s short, but it should give you a feel for what we’re going for.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔜 What’s coming in the full version:[/h3][list][*][p]More biomes with unique environments and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle customization: wheels, upgrades, paint jobs, license plates[/p][/*][*][p]Strategic exploration to find resources and stay alive[/p][/*][*][p]Encounters with enemies, bandits, and more[/p][/*][*][p]Tough choices and meaningful routes that shape each trip[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]💬 Player Feedback[/h3][p]If you’ve got a minute, we’d appreciate your feedback. Just hit the button below — it helps more than you think. We’ll randomly pick [b]5 responses[/b] to receive a [b]free full-game key[/b] at launch.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/PGUm8trQJj1eSeJj7" style="button"]Player Survey[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing our game![/p]
